question_text: A local government employee posts a defamatory statement about a private citizen on a public Facebook group. The citizen files a complaint under RA 10175. Which of the following best describes the liability of the employee?

options.text: The employee cannot be held liable because the post was made outside of work hours and using a personal device.
The employee is liable for cyber libel under RA 10175, regardless of the time or device used, as long as the post is defamatory and accessed by a third party.
The employee is only liable if the post was made using a government-issued device or during office hours.
The employee is exempt from liability because RA 10175 only applies to private individuals, not government employees.
